subject: reasoning
question:
On folding the given die, which number will be opposite to the number 9?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a37b1fa0cefd46f000a8d56e2d3a7bfed0121441aeb01bc7f0e466aa6ca47279.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/325667b9724d48e602dba81afcdf6b7544c5e275089ff1763ee56c415e90f376.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

7 → 9

5 → 8

2 → 3

Therefore, '7' is the opposite of '9'.

Hence, "7" is the correct answer.
